interface.shortDescription: Direct films from the material you actually have.
interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts, created by the objekts film, advertising and AI/VFX/CGI studio, reviews the user’s available creative material: an idea, any number of images, written scenes, video, audio, or mixed references. It turns observed evidence and author intentions into meaningful directing choices, continuity locks, shot construction, montage and a portable brief. The public MCP provides stateless metadata inventory, exact keyed-lock checks and source-bound packet compilation. It does not automatically see media, store private projects, perform human studio review or submit enquiries.
interface.developerName: objekts — film, advertising, AI/VFX & CGI production studio
